summary: An ansible-core breaking change in Ansible 10.0.0: nested templating in assert may stop the conditional from being evaluated.
questions: Why does my assert with nested templates fail in Ansible 10?
Is nested templating in assert a breaking change?

answer_card.title: assert nested templating breaking change
answer_card.answer_md: In Ansible 10, nested templating in `assert` conditions may stop them from being evaluated. Reference variables directly instead of embedding `{{ }}` in `that:`.
